output.reason: The linked issue and PR describe the change concretely. The subject is the ApplicationSet GitLab SCM provider's path-exists check, used when an SCM-provider generator filters on a path existing in the repository [ev-d0ef263f1295, ev-b4f58b170b5e, ev-158dad7eef6f]. The problem was that GitLab's ListTree API returned 404 for a file path, so generation failed with "error listing repos ... 404" and syncing stopped [ev-6b51fe823e04]. The fix lists the entries of the parent folder instead, which the PR says is not a real behaviour change beyond fixing the 404 [ev-b4f58b170b5e, ev-712e0ac0fa22]. That is enough for applicability (GitLab SCM-provider ApplicationSets with path filters) and consequence (the generation failure is fixed). However, a later commit in the same release reverts this parent-folder search and instead treats 404 as "file not found" [ev-dc295e9fc56b], so the typed assertion should reflect the behaviour that actually shipped, or link to that revert.
